# Foundations pipeline fixtures

These bodies and the SVG are test inputs, not reviewed educational content.
They are not registered in content/foundations/index.ts and have no public route.
The en and vi directories exercise the same MDX transform as real articles.
The illustration directory is a test public root supplied to validation.

Fixtures use synthetic source metadata in the test suite; those dates and URLs
are not verification records for real technical claims. Existing snippet files
are referenced to check the real display-region/highlighting pipeline.
